title: Roast beef and potatoes
description: A dialogue lesson in which Sam visits Carol and Tom; Tom is upstairs having a bath, then offers Sam a cigarette and a glass of whisky. When Carol says dinner is nearly ready, Tom mentions that Sam and he had lunch at a restaurant — roast beef and potatoes — and Carol is disappointed because they're going to have roast beef and potatoes again tonight. Workbook practice covers dialogue fill-in, rewriting sentences with the verb 'have', and writing numbers in figures. Grammar exercises combine sentence pairs with 'have', answer questions using cues with 'have', and match questions with answers.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (why is Carol disappointed) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (dialogue fill-in) 10 blanks are taken from the supplied Lesson 81 key (img/key-080-085.jpg). Practice B (rewrite with 'have') 6 items are suggested model answers following the underlined-verb pattern. Practice C (numbers in figures) 6 items are suggested model answers. Grammar I (combine sentences) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-6 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 511). Grammar II (answer the questions) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 512). Grammar III (match questions with answers) 12 items are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 512). No external sources were used.

lesson.text: Listen then answer this question. Why is Carol disappointed? 听录音，然后回答问题。为什么卡罗尔感到失望？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording, then answer: Why is Carol disappointed?

lines.translation: 萨姆：你好，卡罗尔！汤姆在哪儿？

lesson.title: Listening — answer the question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Why is Carol disappointed? 听录音，然后回答问题。为什么卡罗尔感到失望？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue.

questions.prompt: Why is Carol disappointed?
questions.answer: Because Tom and Sam had roast beef and potatoes for lunch, and they're going to have roast beef and potatoes again for dinner.

items.title: He's upstairs.
items.text: 在第13课中我们见到了这样的句子：Come upstairs ...，其中的 upstairs 表示动作的方向。本课中的 He's upstairs. 则表示他的方位，其中的 upstairs 可译为"在楼上"。

items.title: He's having a bath.
items.text: 他正在洗澡。在本课中，动词 have 后面接名词或名词短语，有"进行"、"从事"的意思，如 have a bath, have a cigarette, have a glass of whisky, have dinner, have lunch 等。

lesson.text:
参考译文
萨姆：你好，卡罗尔！汤姆在哪儿？
卡罗尔：他在楼上。他正在洗澡。
卡罗尔：汤姆！
汤姆：什么事？
卡罗尔：萨姆来了。
汤姆：我马上就好。
汤姆：你好，萨姆。请抽烟。
萨姆：不，谢谢，汤姆。
汤姆：那么，来杯威士忌吧。
萨姆：好的，谢谢。
汤姆：卡罗尔，饭好了吗？
卡罗尔：马上就好。7点钟我们可以吃饭。
汤姆：我和萨姆今天一起吃的午饭。我们去了一家饭店。
卡罗尔：你们吃什么？
汤姆：我们吃的是烤牛肉和土豆。
卡罗尔：噢！
汤姆：怎么了，卡罗尔？
卡罗尔：唉，今晚你们又要吃烤牛肉和土豆了！

grammar.title: I. Combine each pair of sentences according to the example. 仿照例句合并下列句子。
grammar.instruction:
Combine each pair of sentences according to the example. 仿照例句合并下列句子。
Example: Mr. Scott usually drinks coffee for breakfast. / Mr. Scott usually eats bread for breakfast. → Mr. Scott usually has coffee and bread for breakfast.
grammar.translation: Combine each pair of sentences using the verb 'have'.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=511
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-6 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 511).

questions.prompt: 1. Mr. Scott usually drinks coffee for breakfast. / eats bread for breakfast
questions.answer: Mr. Scott usually has coffee and bread for breakfast.

questions.prompt: 2. Jane usually eats eggs for breakfast. / drinks milk for breakfast
questions.answer: Jane usually has eggs and milk for breakfast.

questions.prompt: 3. Sam ate two sandwiches and an apple for lunch yesterday. / drank a glass of beer for lunch yesterday
questions.answer: Sam had two sandwiches, an apple and a glass of beer for lunch yesterday.

questions.prompt: 4. Ann is eating an apple for lunch. / is eating salad for lunch
questions.answer: Ann is having an apple and salad for lunch.

questions.prompt: 5. My friends and I ate roast beef and potatoes for dinner. / drank six glasses of beer for dinner
questions.answer: My friends and I had roast beef, potatoes and six glasses of beer for dinner.

questions.prompt: 6. I sometimes eat cheese after a meal. / eat biscuits after a meal
questions.answer: I sometimes have cheese and biscuits after a meal.

grammar.title: II. Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答问题。
grammar.instruction:
Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答问题。
Example: When do you usually have a bath? (at six thirty in the morning) → I usually have a bath at six thirty in the morning.
grammar.translation: Answer each question using the cue in brackets, following the example pattern.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=512
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-8 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 512).

questions.prompt: 1. When do you usually have a bath? (at six thirty in the morning)
questions.answer: I usually have a bath at six thirty in the morning.

questions.prompt: 2. When did Susan and Jack have a meal in the restaurant? (at six yesterday evening)
questions.answer: Susan and Jack had a meal in the restaurant at six yesterday evening.

questions.prompt: 3. Where did you and your friends have a party two weeks ago? (in my house)
questions.answer: My friends and I had a party in my house two weeks ago.

questions.prompt: 4. Who had a good time in the park last weekend? (all the boys and girls)
questions.answer: All the boys and girls had a good time in the park last weekend.

questions.prompt: 5. When do teachers and students have their summer holiday? (in July and August)
questions.answer: Teachers and students have their summer holiday in July and August.

questions.prompt: 6. When did Tony have a swim in the sea? (last Sunday evening)
questions.answer: Tony had a swim in the sea last Sunday evening.

questions.prompt: 7. Where are the students having their English lesson? (in their classroom)
questions.answer: The students are having their English lesson in their classroom.

questions.prompt: 8. What does your child usually have for breakfast? (two slices of bread with cheese, an egg and milk)
questions.answer: My child usually has two slices of bread with cheese, an egg and milk for breakfast.

grammar.title: III. Match the questions in Column A with the answers in Column B. 将 A 栏中的问题和 B 栏中的答案连起来。
grammar.instruction:
Match the questions in Column A with the answers in Column B. 将 A 栏中的问题和 B 栏中的答案连起来。

A: 1. What are you doing now? / 2. Did you have a good time? / 3. What are you going to do? / 4. What do you usually have for lunch? / 5. Who had a party the night before last? / 6. When do you usually have tea? / 7. What's Steven doing now? / 8. Are they having a swim in the river? / 9. What's Tom going to do? / 10. Where are they going to have a holiday? / 11. What must you do now? / 12. Can we have a talk this afternoon?

B: a. No, they aren't. They are having a swim in the sea. / b. Yes, we can. / c. He's having a bath. / d. He's going to have a rest. / e. They're going to have a holiday in the country. / f. I must have a drink. / g. Yes, we did. / h. Those tourists from Korea did. / i. I'm having a French lesson. / j. I'm going to have a haircut. / k. I usually have vegetables and fruit. / l. We usually have tea at four in the afternoon.
grammar.translation: Match each question with its correct answer.
